about.title: About jobby MD Editor
about.sig_thanks: Special thanks to Maround Boutanos for the tooltip & design folding suggestions.
about.desc_html:
A premium Markdown resume editor designed to blend elegant aesthetics with flawless ATS (Applicant Tracking System) compliance.

Need help? Check our Help Guide & Markdown Syntax.
about.why_md_text: Markdown separates content from formatting. This guarantees that Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) can parse your resume's text flawlessly without getting tripped up by complex hidden document structures (like tables or text boxes in Word/PDFs). It also keeps your resume future-proof, portable, and easy to edit.
about.ai_text: Markdown is the ultimate asset when collaborating with AI tools (like Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude). We highly recommend manipulating and tailoring your CV using your favorite AI. Just remember to explicitly prompt it to "generate in MD format", so you can copy and paste the raw text cleanly directly into Jobby without formatting loss!
about.privacy_intro: Jobby is a personal, non-commercial project. We care deeply about your privacy and adhere to GDPR / RGPD guidelines:
about.privacy_bullets_html:
• Private CV Content: We do not collect, store, or transmit any of your resume text, candidate details, or compiled files. Your data is processed entirely locally within your browser.
  • Local Drafts: Your markdown drafts and design choices are saved locally in your browser's localStorage (or directly in your own files if using the File System Access API).
  • Anonymous Telemetry:• Purpose: To analyze design preset adoption, monitor ATS scorecard failure rates (to refine compliance rules), track feature clicks, and monitor compiler rendering performance.
    • Privacy Level: Highly restricted and anonymous. A persistent, random anonymous ID is stored in your browser's localStorage. No personal data, names, IP addresses, or location trackers are collected or linked to telemetry.
  • User Feedback (Voluntary):• Purpose: To process user suggestions, bug reports, and quality ratings.
    • Privacy Level: We only receive details you explicitly submit through the form (rating, category, text, and optional name/email).
about.disclaimer_text: The creator of Jobby explicitly disclaims all liability and responsibility for any user-generated content, resumes, or document outputs created using this editor. Users are solely responsible for the correctness, appropriateness, and legality of the files they compile.

help.desc: Jobby leverages standard Markdown to compile premium, print-ready CV documents. It is purely text with special characters, so it is extremely easy to read. Below is the complete reference of all standard Markdown features supported, custom styling tags, and recommendations.
help.ext_muted_desc: De-emphasize text (light gray) while leaving it 100% readable by ATS scanners. Ex: :muted[Driver's License]
help.ext_contact_desc: Auto-formats contact details with icons. Separate values with vertical bars |.
help.ai_desc_html:
Markdown is your best asset when using AI to build your CV. When manipulating and optimizing your CV with your favorite AI model (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.), always instruct it to:
"Generate the final CV in clean MD format"This ensures you can simply copy and paste the raw output directly into Jobby with zero layout distortion.
